mapper.select: SELECT p.product_no AS productNo, p.name AS name, p.price AS price, p.discount_rate AS discountRate, p.category_id AS categoryId, p.description AS description, p.use_yn AS useYn, p.created_at AS createdAt, p.updated_at AS updatedAt, p.view_count AS viewCount, p.same_day_delivery_yn AS sameDayDeliveryYn FROM product p WHERE p.product_no = #{productNo}

SELECT p.product_no AS productNo, p.name AS name, p.price AS price, p.discount_rate AS discountRate, p.category_id AS categoryId, p.description AS description, p.use_yn AS useYn, p.created_at AS createdAt, p.updated_at AS updatedAt, p.view_count AS viewCount, p.same_day_delivery_yn AS sameDayDeliveryYn FROM product p ORDER BY p.product_no DESC

SELECT p.product_no AS productNo, p.name AS name, p.price AS price, p.price AS salePrice, p.discount_rate AS discountRate, pi.image_url AS imageUrl FROM product p LEFT JOIN product_img pi ON pi.product_no = p.product_no AND pi.image_type = 'THUMB' WHERE p.use_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY p.created_at DESC, p.product_no DESC

SELECT p.product_no AS productNo, p.name AS name, p.price AS price, p.discount_rate AS discountRate, pi.image_url AS imageUrl, p.category_id AS categoryId, p.same_day_delivery_yn AS sameDayDeliveryYn, p.created_at AS createdAt FROM product p LEFT JOIN product_img pi ON pi.product_no = p.product_no AND pi.image_type = 'THUMB' WHERE p.use_yn = 'Y'
AND p.category_id IN ( SELECT c.category_id FROM category c WHERE c.use_yn = 'Y' START WITH c.category_id = #{categoryId} CONNECT BY PRIOR c.category_id = c.parent_id )
AND p.name LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%'
AND p.created_at >= SYSTIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '7' DAY
ORDER BY p.created_at DESC, p.product_no DESC
ORDER BY p.discount_rate DESC, p.product_no DESC
ORDER BY p.view_count DESC, p.product_no DESC
ORDER BY p.created_at DESC, p.product_no DESC

SELECT p.product_no AS productNo, p.name AS name, p.price AS price, p.discount_rate AS discountRate, pi.image_url AS imageUrl, p.same_day_delivery_yn AS sameDayDeliveryYn, p.created_at AS createdAt FROM product p LEFT JOIN product_img pi ON pi.product_no = p.product_no AND pi.image_type = 'THUMB' WHERE p.use_yn = 'Y' AND p.created_at >= SYSTIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '7' DAY ORDER BY p.created_at DESC, p.product_no DESC FETCH FIRST 8 ROWS ONLY

SELECT p.product_no AS productNo, p.name AS name, p.price AS price, p.discount_rate AS discountRate, pi.image_url AS imageUrl, p.same_day_delivery_yn AS sameDayDeliveryYn, p.created_at AS createdAt FROM product p LEFT JOIN product_img pi ON pi.product_no = p.product_no AND pi.image_type = 'THUMB' WHERE p.use_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY p.view_count DESC, p.product_no DESC FETCH FIRST 8 ROWS ONLY

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT p.product_no AS productNo, p.name AS name, p.price AS price, p.discount_rate AS discountRate, pi.image_url AS imageUrl, p.same_day_delivery_yn AS sameDayDeliveryYn, p.created_at AS createdAt FROM product p LEFT JOIN product_img pi ON pi.product_no = p.product_no AND pi.image_type = 'THUMB' WHERE p.use_yn = 'Y' AND p.discount_rate > 0 ORDER BY p.discount_rate DESC, p.product_no DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 8

SELECT p.product_no AS productNo, p.name AS name, p.price AS price, p.discount_rate AS discountRate, pi.image_url AS imageUrl, p.same_day_delivery_yn AS sameDayDeliveryYn, p.created_at AS createdAt FROM product p LEFT JOIN product_img pi ON pi.product_no = p.product_no AND pi.image_type = 'THUMB' WHERE p.use_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY p.product_no DESC FETCH FIRST 8 ROWS ONLY
SELECT * FROM ( SELECT p.name AS name, p.view_count AS viewCount FROM product p WHERE p.use_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY p.view_count DESC, p.product_no DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 10
mapper.update: UPDATE product SET view_count = view_count + 1 WHERE product_no = #{productNo}
mapper.select: SELECT p.product_no AS productNo, p.name AS name, p.price AS price, p.price AS salePrice, p.discount_rate AS discountRate, pi.image_url AS imageUrl FROM product p LEFT JOIN product_img pi ON pi.product_no = p.product_no AND pi.image_type = 'THUMB' WHERE p.use_yn = 'Y' AND p.product_no != #{productNo} AND p.category_id IN ( SELECT c.category_id FROM category c WHERE c.use_yn = 'Y' START WITH c.category_id = ( SELECT NVL(cur.parent_id, cur.category_id) FROM category cur WHERE cur.category_id = #{categoryId} ) CONNECT BY PRIOR c.category_id = c.parent_id ) ORDER BY p.created_at DESC, p.product_no DESC FETCH FIRST 4 ROWS ONLY
